title: Add a background-work ledger and npm run bench:idle
summary: The Rust daemon ships inside the Mac app and carries the app's live connection.

sections.title: What this ship changes for you
items: The Rust daemon ships inside the Mac app and carries the app's live connection. If it stops, the app falls back to the built-in one. Set `O8_WS_O8D=0` to turn it off.
With no agent running and no window in front, the server pauses most of its background loops.
The server no longer rebuilds the phone inbox each time git activity touches a registered repository.
A queued message is delivered when it is added. It used to wait up to 5 seconds.
A mission whose packets never launched can be archived from the command line.
Saying the cancel phrase drops a dictation even when the polish step can't be reached.
A Rust library the app uses for web addresses is updated for a published security advisory.

sections.title: Performance
items: List review targets again only when a worktree store can have changed
Report awake minutes and what kept the gate awake in bench:idle
Skip re-reading linked chats and settings while unchanged
Scan stored missions for a remedy only when a stored mission changed
Reuse owner packet lookups until a stored mission changes
Defer worker correction actions
Skip unsolicited mobile inbox builds
Stop capacity, approvals, bots and visualization reads while nobody can see the window
